reply_text:
I replied to Pree in a thread on her correction: the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is at Gate 47, not Dock 23.

My first reply in that thread said gbrain was still blocking me. That was wrong, because I posted it before actually trying. I then tried the save and it went through, and I posted a second reply in the thread to correct myself. gbrain now has one fact for Marrow Agrisupply saying Gate 47. It never had Dock 23, because this morning's search was refused and I didn't attempt a save then.

Two things remain:
- Pree's original Dock 23 message is still in #central-team with nothing linking it to the correction. She may want to edit it or reply to it in its own thread.
- gbrain says many of its other functions are switched off for this connection. Whoever runs the gbrain server can check with `gbrain doctor --only grant_new_ops_available --json`.
